decisions.reason: Uses LinkType Junction + Target {E:\dev\dsh-attach-input} and the link: marker to establish the profile entry resolves to the repo tree; shows copying through the junction is a self-copy and distinguishes copied installs.

Attributes file locks and stale module state to the running host process; explains closing the tab releases nothing (browser holds no handles); separately explains browser HTTP-cache staleness and why host restart plus cache-bypassing refresh are needed, without treating browser caching as a filesystem lock.

Explains renames through the junction renamed the sole source files so the follow-up copy lost its source; recovery renames .old2 back to client.js/index.js preserving content, verifies with node --check, stops the host first as precaution, deletes nothing.

Order is semantically correct: fully stop host, restore/verify files, restart dsh web, hard-refresh bypassing cache, then verify feature and load errors; explicitly says browser restart is unnecessary.

Prescribes LinkType/Target introspection plus the cordis.patch.yml link marker before any file operation, with branching for linked vs copied installs, and explains why generic copy-into-node_modules advice caused the incident.

caps.reason: Final plan explicitly forbids any copy and renames the .old2 files back; the two paths are treated as one directory.
The plan requires a full host stop and restart; browser refresh is only the cache layer.
